settings.text: Pre-owned luxury runs on trust. This is exactly how we earn it — for every single piece, every single time.

settings.title: Two specialists, two opinions
settings.text: Each piece is authenticated separately by two members of our team, who examine materials, stitching, hardware, heat stamps and date codes. If they don't agree, it doesn't go on sale.

settings.title: Graded against its photos
settings.text: We compare the item in hand with its listing images and grade it on our six-step scale. Every scuff, mark or sign of use is described in the condition report.

settings.title: Filmed from shelf to box
settings.text: The final inspection and packing are recorded in one continuous take. A card in your parcel links to the film, so you can see exactly what we saw.

settings.title: New
settings.text: Unused, with original packaging. No signs of wear.

settings.title: Pristine
settings.text: Used once or twice. Virtually indistinguishable from new.

settings.title: Excellent
settings.text: Very light wear only visible on close inspection.

settings.title: Very good
settings.text: Light signs of use, such as faint marks or softened corners.

settings.title: Good
settings.text: Visible wear consistent with regular use, fully functional.

settings.question: What happens if an item fails authentication?
settings.answer: It's rejected and returned to the seller. It never reaches our shop.

settings.question: Is my purchase guaranteed?
settings.answer: Yes. If an item you bought from us is ever proven not to be authentic, we'll refund you in full.

settings.question: How do I watch my item's recording?
settings.answer: Scan the code on the card included in your parcel, or find the link in your order confirmation email.
